versions.changelog:
shutter-speed-motion v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Helps users select shutter speed to control motion rendering (freeze/convey movement) for moving subjects.
- Provides step-by-step guidance: evaluates subject speed, direction, distance, and lens focal length.
- Differentiates from depth-of-field or exposure control; focuses on creative motion choices and panning technique.
- Includes fail-safes for camera shake and modern context notes.
